note: Lattice-MUD shaped Fog tables. Normative ontology: docs/SUBJECT-OBJECT-ECONOMY.md, docs/STRATA_NFT_ONTOLOGY.md, docs/DIGITAL-OBJECTS.md. Not an EVM world. No USDC. No on-chain STRATA emission except PoC-gated stubs.

layers.subjects: Account/Subject — User | SCA/ACB (same being). Never inventory.
layers.objects: object_id STRATA NFT — bytes/cid/name can stand without ever running a contrato block.
layers.aspectos: Contained child objects (tree, no cycles). Not the word for contracts.
layers.contrato: Optional rules block on an object (StateMachine/Actions/collateral) OR a catalog ownership title. Never named aspecto.
layers.infrastructure: Fog node / hops — never Subject, never Object.
layers.fungible: STRATA balance on Account — dashboard wallet. Not an NFT.
layers.lots: Catalog trade-lot rows for fungible STRATA bundles — NOT object_id / NOT NFT.
layers.ownership_fraction: Subject claim on NFT collateral C (strata_units). Sold on Agora at P_market in fungible STRATA; P_market ≠ C×fraction.
layers.collateral: Fungible STRATA inside the NFT. static=reserve (floor); dynamic=burn above floor for execution; ≠ dashboard Balance; ≠ P_market.

rules: SCA (PT) and ACB (EN) are the same subject class — equal standing to users
SCA/ACB are subjects not objects
Subjects own/operate objects; subjects are never rows in Object
Fog node is infrastructure — no Subject row for the Node
Desk external_assistant agents are not SCA/ACB
object_id is the STRATA NFT identity (network id) — never equal to cid
CID-only persist allowed without minting object_id
STRATA NFT = object; optional contrato block does not exhaust the object
kind=lot is FORBIDDEN here — lots are not NFTs (see Lot)
kind=parcel => unmovable=true (dirt/aspect of open-world land); trade title, not the parcel row
kind=room => actual rooms only (e.g. Bancada) — not every parcel
kind=bundle => objects-inside-object tree (aspectos); no cycles
SCA/ACB must not appear in this table
Parcel object_id is unmovable land identity in the open-world bundle
Renderer shows ownership contrato of that parcel — not a drop of the land NFT itself
Trading land = trade title (contrato / title instrument), never move parcel object_id into inventory
bundle_object_id points at the land-bundle object; title held by a Subject (e.g. account email), not by Fog NODE_WALLET as citizen
Catalog trade lot — fungible bundle representation
lot_id is NOT object_id and NOT an NFT
ERC-1155 scaffold may mirror lots; still not land and not Subject
Never call a contrato an aspecto
ownership_title: tradable title over unmovable parcel/bundle objects
spa_aps: specialized STRATA NFT service agreement (static/dynamic/terminated) — competes with EVM mechanics without importing ETH ontology
Optional interior contrato block on an object is rules/collateral — object can exist with has_contrato_block=false
SPA/APS static reserves collateral; dynamic burns above floor; ownership fractions trade on Agora at P_market ≠ C
Aspectos = contained objects (children). Tree, no cycles.
Child remains its own object_id (own tank/Still/Live if it has that block)
Not a contract; not a pipeline step; not DAG parents
Fungible STRATA lives on the subject dashboard wallet — not in the NFT catalog
Mint only PdC / PoC-gated; no faucet
Hire/labour moves STRATA by transfer — zero mint
Ownership of NFT = subjects that own the collateralised STRATA of that NFT
Agora may sell this ownership portion at P_market in fungible STRATA
P_market is not the collateral value that the ownership portion represents
Redeem when P_market < C is distinct from an Agora ownership trade
static: collateral reserves (floor reserved)
dynamic: NFT burns its own mechanisms — burn C above floor for execution
terminated: residual to titulares
C is inside the NFT — not subject dashboard Balance and not Agora P_market
